ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited has approved a significant capital expenditure of approximately ₹495.5 crores for capacity expansion in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh. This material investment includes setting up a new 66 MN BL per year dual-mode distillery and nearly doubling IMFL bottling capacity from ~6 MN to ~13 MN cases per year, aiming to bolster supply security, improve margins through captive consumption, and meet increasing regional demand. While financed through a combination of debt and internal accruals, there are no immediate red flags, indicating a strategic growth initiative.
